title: Batter piles.
officialText: The connection between batter piles and grade beams or pile caps shall be designed to resist the nom-inal strength of the pile acting as a short column. Batter piles and their connections shall be capable of resisting forces and moments from the load combinations of Section 12.4 of ASCE 7-10.
